scene: The friendly shopkeeper serves tea, pointing outside toward three waiting departures.
picture: A flat side view along a wide wooden terrace under open skies. On the far left sits a glass-bottomed boat beside a pier. Centre, the lanky boy holds a steaming mug beside the smiling shopkeeper. Up high sways a tethered red-striped hot-air balloon. On the far right waits a sleigh tram on icy rails.
shown: a glass-bottomed boat waiting at the hill's pier on the far left
a tethered hot-air balloon with open basket swaying up high
a runnered sleigh tram idling on frosted rails to the far right
